note: Media primitives (issue #88). The explainer film "A company's first decade, in one minute", its captions, poster and gallery stills are self-made: drawn frame by frame in code from the storyboard src/components/media/decade.ts and encoded by WE, reproducible with src/assets/video/tools/render-decade.mjs. Every figure in the film, captions, transcript and milestone carousel is a register statistic (src/data/sales/stats.ts) already fetched and recorded by WP-58 (.astro-magazine/sources/wp-58.json, retrieved 2026-10-14); no new fetches were made. Between years 1, 5 and 10 the ring of 100 lights is interpolated for the drawing only, and the transcript says so.
